settings.title: Replace Your AC Before the Next Breakdown

settings.editor: Waiting until your air conditioner fails completely can leave you making a rushed decision during the hottest part of the year. If your system is aging, inefficient, or becoming unreliable, planning your AC replacement ahead of time gives you more control over comfort, budget, timing, and equipment options.

At Lenz Heating & Cooling, we provide professional air conditioning replacement for homeowners across the Des Moines metro. Whether your AC needs frequent repairs, cools unevenly, runs constantly, uses outdated refrigerant, or cannot keep up with summer humidity, our technicians can evaluate your system and explain whether repair or replacement is the better long-term choice.

Lenz Heating & Cooling helps Des Moines homeowners make practical replacement decisions without pressure. Our technicians inspect your current system, explain what is happening, and help you decide whether replacement makes sense or if repair is still a reasonable option.
Scheduling an AC replacement evaluation can help you:

settings.html:
• Avoid emergency replacement during peak summer heat
  • Compare repair versus replacement without pressure
  • Plan around your budget and available comfort options
  • Improve comfort in rooms that are hard to cool
  • Reduce energy waste from an aging system
  • Lower the risk of repeated repair costs
  • Choose a cooling solution that fits your home, ductwork, and long-term needs
Signs to watch

settings.title: Signs It May Be Time to Replace Your AC
Your AC Is Old Enough That Every Repair Feels Like a Gamble

settings.editor:
Most air conditioners have a limited service life. If your system is 10 to 15 years old or older, every repair decision becomes more important. Age alone does not always mean replacement is required, but it does raise the question of how much more money you want to invest in aging equipment.

If your older system also struggles to cool, needs frequent repairs, or causes rising energy bills, AC replacement may be the better long-term option.

settings.title: You Are Paying for Repairs, But Comfort Problems Keep Coming Back

settings.editor:
An occasional repair may be normal, especially as equipment ages. But if you are calling for service every summer, replacing parts repeatedly, or dealing with the same comfort problems again and again, repair costs can add up quickly.

Replacing an unreliable air conditioner can help reduce repair stress and give your home a more dependable cooling solution before the next breakdown.

settings.title: Your AC Runs Longer, But Your Home Still Does Not Feel Better

settings.editor:
Older air conditioners often have to work harder to produce the same level of cooling. Worn parts, reduced efficiency, airflow problems, and outdated technology can all contribute to longer run times and higher energy use.

If your energy bills keep climbing while your home still feels warm, humid, or uneven, your AC may be losing efficiency. Replacing the system can help improve cooling performance and energy use during hot Central Iowa summers.

If one room feels comfortable while another stays warm, your cooling system may no longer be moving air effectively through the home. Uneven cooling can be caused by ductwork issues, poor airflow, system age, or equipment that is no longer keeping up.

Before recommending replacement, airflow and ductwork should also be evaluated. A new AC cannot perform its best if the duct system is leaking, restricted, or poorly sized. Lenz Heating & Cooling can help determine whether the issue is with the air conditioner, the ductwork, or both.

settings.title: Your AC Struggles During Hot, Humid Weather

settings.editor:
An air conditioner that works fine on mild days but struggles during peak summer heat may be nearing the end of its useful life. You may notice longer run times, weak cooling, sticky indoor air, or rooms that never reach the thermostat setting.

Central Iowa summers can put a lot of demand on older cooling systems. If your AC cannot keep up when you need it most, replacing it before a complete failure can help restore comfort and peace of mind.

Some older air conditioners use refrigerants that are no longer commonly used in new equipment. If your system develops a refrigerant leak or needs related repairs, service may become more expensive or less practical over time.

If your older AC uses outdated refrigerant and has other performance issues, replacement may make more sense than continuing to invest in repairs.
Call us and we'll give you an honest answer.
